# Mew Finance smart contracts

The ErgoScript source of every contract that [Mew Finance](https://mewfinance.com) apps use on the
Ergo mainnet. One command proves the sources match the chain:

```bash
npm install
npm run verify          # recompile each source and compare it, byte for byte, with the deployed address
npm run verify:chain    # also check Lithos Lock against mainnet and count boxes at each contract
```

[`deployed.json`](deployed.json) pins each source to its address and its compile settings.
All contracts are ErgoTree v1, compiled with `@fleet-sdk/compiler` 0.10.0.

## Live contracts

| app | contract | what it does | address |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Mart](https://mart.mewfinance.com) | [Sell v2](contracts/mart/sell.es) | List a token or NFT for a price in ERG or a token. A buyer pays the seller, and the fee address receives the fee (at least 2%). The seller can cancel at any time. | [`H3AA3MD4…RZH9pH`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.) |
| Mart | [Escrow sell v2](contracts/mart/escrow-sell.es) | Like Sell, but only the buyer named in R8 can buy. | [`3gb1RaJd…LJJRHb`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.) |
| Mart | [Offer v2](contracts/mart/offer.es) | A standing offer of ERG and/or tokens for an amount of one token. The offerer receives that token at OUTPUTS(0), the fee address its fee (at least 2%); the offerer can cancel at any time. | [`GXZnpeud…pSQX7x`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.) |
| Mart | [Escrow offer v2](contracts/mart/escrow-offer.es) | Like Offer, but only the counterparty named in R8 can fill it. | [`3bduwyQL…GPSRSY`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.) |
| Mart | [Partial fill V3](contracts/mart/partial-fill-v3.es) | A fungible token listing that can be bought in parts. | [`PxjYkwKG…5S1xYJ`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.) |
| [Lend](https://lend.mewfinance.com) | [Lend v2](contracts/lend/lend.es) | A lender offers a loan. A borrower takes it by posting collateral and paying the lending fee (the fee address receives at least 3% of that fee). If the borrower repays before expiry, the collateral comes back. Otherwise, after expiry, the lender takes the collateral. | [`8cztyVEf…MfRapD`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.) |
| [Mew Lock](https://lock.mewfinance.com) | [Mew Lock v2](contracts/mew-lock/lock.es) | Time lock: only the owner can withdraw, and only from the unlock height on. Withdrawal pays a 3% fee. | [`kcxXdmrw…9sUAj4`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.) |
| [Lithos Lock](https://lock.mewfinance.com/lithos) | [Campaign v3](contracts/lithos-lock/campaign-v3.es) | Lock LIT for 30, 90, 180 or 365 days and earn more LIT. One box per campaign holds the reward budget and fixes each lock's reward when it locks, on a curve that can never promise more than the budget. Anyone can top it up; after the end, anyone can sweep the leftover, but only to the address compiled into it. | [`aza3aKaX…RThfMa`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.) |
| Lithos Lock | [Position](contracts/lithos-lock/position.es) | One box per lock, holding the locked LIT and its reward: only the owner can spend it, and only from the unlock height on. | [`HP4Dp7Bo…sF5SdZ`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.com/en/addresses/HP4Dp7BojEaMUQhmh7MbqbHcZvsF5SdZ) |
| [mewfinance.com](https://mewfinance.com) | [MEOW staking](contracts/meow-staking/stake.es) | MEOW staking for tiers: the box must hold MEOW first, and only the depositor can take it back. | [`2Czxg7U5…8zh4Cp`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.com/en/addresses/2Czxg7U54ZzDcguzu4zt6SEfu9oUm4t5MH7Qsdt5pmVrbqqR9U1hwxSdpnzJ2Vo9EnSNtvVyYmcTzQWFtSVa8zh4Cp) |
| Lottery | [Prize redeem](contracts/lottery/prize-redeem.es) | A prize box: whoever spends the winning ticket token in the same transaction can take it. | [`k8sGMfL3…KgY5zp`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.com/en/addresses/k8sGMfL3LjdnQpCat9jyThDJZ3aEniCD9y65779oEjV9375QFXHXUke3aQKRgZtGKgY5zp) |
| [Burn](https://burn.mewfinance.com) | [Programmatic burn v2](contracts/burn/programmatic-burn.es) | Scheduled burn: from the height in R4 anyone can trigger it, and the tokens are destroyed. | [`4HPn1j7Q…Qhuw9s`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.com/en/addresses/4HPn1j7Q26Y5Ppq7w2KYgznrBEWv7oN4HAWb5xSFqo1Qr9hWpd7u31zpJsUQPDnzc3Qhuw9s) |

A Lithos Lock campaign has its parameters compiled in, so each campaign has its own address; the
one above is Season 1. New campaigns use [`campaign.es`](contracts/lithos-lock/campaign.es)
(v4). The parameters, the reward curve and the audit are in
[`contracts/lithos-lock`](contracts/lithos-lock).

## Previous versions

Boxes at these addresses stay spendable under their own rules, and the apps still serve the
orders, loans and locks they hold.

In June 2026 our backend server was compromised (see the
[security incident report](https://mewfinance.com/security)). The fee address compiled into
several contracts was rotated, so each of them was replaced by a copy with only the fee key
changed, and MEOW staking replaced MEW staking (only the token id changed). No contract was
exploited in the incident.

| app | contract | replaced | address |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Mart](https://mart.mewfinance.com) | [Sell v1](legacy/mart/sell-2026-06.es) | 2026-10, by Sell v2 | [`2DnYaspU…ZMyxKv`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.) |
| Mart | [Sell v1, old fee key](legacy/mart/sell.es) | 2026-06, fee key rotated | [`2DnYaspU…7M3uw8`](https://explorer.ergoplatform.) |

## Layout

```
contracts/<app>/*.es   live contracts
legacy/<app>/*.es      earlier versions (dated files: replaced 2026-10)
deployed.json          source → address (or Lithos deployment file) for every contract
scripts/verify.mjs     the check behind npm run verify
```
